title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 249 ]

blocks.text: Suppose two friends of mine are sitting in my room. One is 165cm tall and the other is 175cm tall. Which do you think is a man and which is a woman? In the absence of other information, you probably conclude that the shorter one is a woman while the taller one is a man. Where does this conclusion come from? Your experience tells you that men tend to be taller than women. So, From the particular men and women you have known, you draw a conclusion about men and women as a whole. In this way, many of your day-to-day judgments and guesses depend on your experience.
